mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waiting_interaction (tenant_id, device_resource_id, device_session_id, workflow_step_id, interaction_id, status, state_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceResourceId}, #{deviceSessionId}, #{workflowStepId}, #{interactionId}, #{status}, #{stateVersion}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_resource_id, device_session_id, interaction_id) DO UPDATE SET workflow_step_id = EXCLUDED.workflow_step_id, status = EXCLUDED.status, state_version = EXCLUDED.state_version, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, status AS "status", interaction_id AS "interactionId", state_version AS "stateVersion" FROM waiting_interaction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND device_resource_id = #{deviceResourceId} AND device_session_id = #{deviceSessionId} AND (workflow_step_id = #{workflowStepId} OR workflow_step_id IS NULL) AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE waiting_interaction SET status = 'CONSUMED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING'
